verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API, so live streaming transcription is a fair axis to judge it on. Its documentation describes only prerecorded file transcription: you submit a URL or upload a file up to 2 GiB, jobs run asynchronously, and short files can be sent to the synchronous Edge API. The SSE option streams progress and transcript segments for an already-submitted file job; it does not accept live audio input over a WebSocket or streaming endpoint, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
